description:
Cast Changeling Outcast by paying {B}.
Changeling Outcast enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Sethron.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sethron trigger, creating a 2/2 Minotaur creature token.
The Minotaur enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Changeling Outcast from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Minotaur token, adding {B}.
Repeat.
